# Requirements Quality Checklist: Vender tokens de un jugador (SPEC-011)

**Purpose**: Evaluar la calidad de los requisitos de SPEC-011 y su coherencia con los artefactos de diseño, como prueba unitaria de la especificación escrita. Cubre `spec.md`, `plan.md`, `research.md`, `data-model.md`, `contracts/` y `quickstart.md`.
**Created**: 2026-10-17
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 - Are all five operations of the feature stated as explicit requirements (publicar, comprar, cancelar, listar mercado, listar propias y detalle)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, §FR-012, §FR-025, §FR-026, §FR-027, §FR-028]
- [x] CHK002 - Is the complete set of rejection reasons documented with their HTTP status and stable error code, without leaving any rejection without a defined response? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003, §FR-005, §FR-006, §FR-016, §FR-017, §FR-018, §FR-019]
- [x] CHK003 - Are the data a publication must persist specified completely: jugador, cantidad, precio unitario, importe, vendedor, creación, vencimiento y estado? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009]
- [x] CHK004 - Are requirements defined for the owner's access to a publication after its player stops being visible, and for the third party's loss of access? [Completeness, Spec §FR-029]
- [x] CHK005 - Is the requirement that a successful publication must not alter any credit balance, must not transfer tokens and must not produce a transaction stated as an obligation, not only as an observation? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001]
- [x] CHK006 - Are requirements defined for the behaviour of the endpoint when the session is absent, invalid or expired, across all operations and not only the purchase? [Completeness, Spec §FR-030]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK007 - Is the term "disponible" defined explicitly as tenencia menos reservas de publicaciones efectivamente activas y no vencidas, and used consistently in the specification and in the contracts? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006; contracts/listings.md]
- [x] CHK008 - Is "estado efectivo" defined unambiguously as the derived outcome of the stored status and the expiry instant, and distinguished from the stored status everywhere it appears? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010, §FR-011, §FR-027]
- [x] CHK009 - Is the quantity range for a publication quantified with an inclusive lower and upper bound, and is the reason the bound exists stated? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004]
- [x] CHK010 - Is "visible en el catálogo" defined by reference to the existing catalogue visibility predicate rather than restated, so that a change in the catalogue does not create a divergent definition? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005, §FR-026]
- [x] CHK011 - Is the monetary unit stated for every amount appearing in requirements and contracts, without any amount left unitless? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007; contracts/listings.md; contracts/buy-listing.md]
- [x] CHK012 - Is the term "reserva" defined as a logical immobilisation that does not transfer ownership, so that it cannot be read as a transfer? [Clarity, Spec §Key Entities]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK013 - Are the two purchase modes of `POST /api/orders/buy` stated so that no single request could satisfy or contradict both, and are the rules for a mixed or incomplete body explicit? [Consistency, Spec §FR-012, §FR-013]
- [x] CHK014 - Is the requirement that the buyer cannot influence player, quantity or price consistent with the request contract, which accepts a body containing those fields alongside `listingId`? [Consistency, Spec §FR-013; contracts/buy-listing.md]
- [x] CHK015 - Are the two 404 codes for player problems, `PLAYER_NOT_FOUND` and `PLAYER_NOT_VISIBLE`, consistent between the publication requirement and the purchase requirement, where a non-visible player instead yields `LISTING_NOT_FOUND`? [Consistency, Spec §FR-005, §FR-019]
- [x] CHK016 - Is the rule that `LISTING_NOT_AVAILABLE` does not distinguish its four causes consistent with the requirement that the seller without a credit account also produces it, and is the indistinguishability stated as an obligation? [Consistency, Spec §FR-018]
- [x] CHK017 - Are the concurrency guarantees in the specification compatible with the lock order and the subset rule stated in the research artifact, without an artifact asserting a stronger guarantee than the design delivers? [Consistency, Spec §FR-020; research.md R-01]
- [x] CHK018 - Is the persistence strategy for the listings table consistent between the design documents, in particular the deletion semantics of its foreign keys? [Consistency, data-model.md; research.md R-08]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK019 - Is every success criterion expressed so that it can be objectively evaluated, without depending on adjectives such as "rápido" or "correcto"? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001 a §SC-014]
- [x] CHK020 - Does each acceptance criterion name observable state before and after the action, in particular quantities, balances and listing status, rather than only the returned code? [Measurability, Spec §AC01 a §AC48]
- [x] CHK021 - Is the absence of a quantified performance target documented as an explicit decision, so that its absence is not read as an omission? [Measurability, Spec §Performance Goals; plan.md]

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK022 - Are requirements defined for the primary path of each of the four user stories, with the resulting state described in each case? [Coverage, Spec §US1 a §US4]
- [x] CHK023 - Are requirements defined for the case where two buyers act on the same publication simultaneously, and is the expected outcome of the losing operation specified with its code? [Coverage, Spec §FR-020, §AC23]
- [x] CHK024 - Are requirements defined for a purchase and a cancellation acting on the same publication simultaneously? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK025 - Are requirements defined for the case where the seller cannot cover the published quantity at the moment of purchase, including the resulting state of the publication? [Coverage, Spec §FR-021]
- [x] CHK026 - Are requirements defined for the seller lacking a valid credit account at the moment of purchase? [Coverage, Spec §FR-018]
- [x] CHK027 - Are requirements defined for a publication created while its player was visible that later stops being visible, covering listing, detail, purchase and the owner's history? [Coverage, Spec §FR-029, §AC37]
- [x] CHK028 - Are requirements defined for the publication being queried with a filter whose value differs in capitalisation from the canonical one? [Coverage, Spec §FR-027]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK029 - Are boundary conditions for the publication quantity addressed explicitly: null, absent, zero, negative, decimal and above the maximum? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-004, §AC03]
- [x] CHK030 - Are boundary conditions for the expiry boundary specified, including whether a publication whose expiry is exactly the current instant is already expired? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-010]
- [x] CHK031 - Are requirements defined for identifiers that are well-formed integers but correspond to nothing, such as zero or negative listing identifiers? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-019; contracts/buy-listing.md]
- [x] CHK032 - Are requirements defined for a body that carries no identifiable field at all, and is the expected response specified? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-004; contracts/buy-listing.md]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [x] CHK033 - Are security requirements defined for authorisation by role and by resource ownership, including the prohibition on the superuser participating in the secondary market? [Security, Spec §FR-002, §FR-003, §FR-017, §FR-025]
- [x] CHK034 - Are requirements defined that rejections do not reveal holdings, reservations, balances or amounts, and are they stated as verifiable obligations? [Security, Spec §FR-006, §FR-016, §FR-033]
- [x] CHK035 - Are audit requirements defined for immutability of the financial record during normal system operations, with the scope of that guarantee made explicit? [Spec §FR-022]
- [x] CHK036 - Are documentation requirements defined for the API surface, including the additions to the existing purchase contract? [Spec §FR-032]
- [x] CHK037 - Is the absence of requirements for load, throughput, latency, notification and automated expiration documented as an explicit exclusion rather than an omission? [Gap, Spec §Out of Scope]

## Dependencies and Assumptions

- [x] CHK038 - Are the functional dependencies on the catalogue visibility predicate, on the market domain and on the quotation source named with the specification they belong to? [Dependency, Spec §Dependencias funcionales]
- [x] CHK039 - Are the assumptions about a real credit account existing for every seller, and about the quotation source being available, stated and justified rather than left implicit? [Assumption, Spec §FR-015, §FR-018]
- [x] CHK040 - Is the dependency on the migration numbering convention documented, including that new migrations follow the timestamp convention? [Dependency, research.md R-05; docs/development/flyway-migrations.md]

## Ambiguities and Conflicts

- [x] CHK041 - Are the deferred points recorded in the specification still open, consistent and each associated with the phase in which they must be resolved? [Traceability, Spec §Puntos pendientes de resolución]
- [x] CHK042 - Does any requirement contradict another requirement, or any requirement contradict a design artifact, without the contradiction being declared as such? [Conflict]
- [x] CHK043 - Is the statement in the specification header describing the state of the Git branch still accurate, given that the branch now exists? [Conflict, Spec §Feature Branch]
- [x] CHK044 - Is the numeric scheme of requirements, acceptance criteria, results and clarifications complete and without gaps, so that any item can be referenced unambiguously? [Traceability, Spec §FR, §AC, §SC, §CL]
